samples.question: Find the gray square bounded by four colored corner marks. Its pixels were recorded one square perimeter at a time, from the outside ring inward, starting at each ring's upper-left corner and walking clockwise; every second ring was recorded in reverse. Restore the square, replace each pixel by the mean of its 9x9 edge-replicated neighborhood, ignore the marks and fine carrier, and read the broad symbol: crescent, lattice, plume, or arrow?
